name: Grow a Mine ⛏️
desc:
💎 Welcome to Grow a Mine! 💎
Are you ready to grow the biggest mine ever? Hire miners from the shop, place them, wait as they dig, and collect the profits! Have fun!

[How To Play]
• Go to the shop and hire a miner!
• Place the miner in your Mine!
• Buy upgrades to boost your miners!
• Hire more miners and upgrade them!

⭐ Your mine keeps working while you’re offline! ⭐
